report: Recurrent diarrhea after antibiotics with bloody/mucoid stools, positive fecal PCR for C. difficile toxin, and colonoscopic erythema from ascending colon to rectum strongly indicate C. difficile infectious colitis. Advanced age, CLL, and antibiotic exposure are risk factors. Post-antibiotic dysbiosis, inflammatory/ischemic colitis, and enteral/medication diarrhea are refuted by bloody/mucoid presentation and confirmed C. diff infection. Absent pseudomembranes and pending biopsy/CMV testing leave CMV colitis as a low-probability concurrent/alternative, not the primary cause.
